theories.claim: ReconcileInterruptedMutation leaves QAPhaseMapped without terminal conversion while RecoverQA converts Mapped to Interrupted, creating divergent recovery paths
theories.basis: internal/sprint/locks.go:83-95 only transitions Queued/Running/Synthesizing to Interrupted; QAPhaseMapped case is absent. internal/sprint/qa.go:223-227 explicitly handles Mapped -> Interrupted in RecoverQA. A crash while mapped but before shard execution leaves durable state ambiguous across the two recovery entry points.
theories.confirmation_condition: Read both functions and confirm Mapped is not handled in ReconcileInterruptedMutation, then inspect a persisted QA state with Phase=mapped after injected process death via ReconcileInterruptedMutation returns unchanged
theories.refutation_condition: Show ReconcileInterruptedMutation intentionally delegates Mapped to later RecoverQA and that call sequence guarantees eventual Interrupted/Stale via QAMap drift check at locks.go:33-96 and qa.go:228-234
theories.inconclusive_condition: Cannot invoke process death or file mutation in read-only mode to observe durable transition
theories.safe_evidence_strategy: Read locks.go, qa.go, qa_state.go; list stored verification/state.json fixtures; search for QAPhaseMapped usages; request no writes

theories.claim: ApprovedQAChecks catalog is empty for non-Go shards so evidence phase silently skips format validation for those changed paths
theories.basis: internal/sprint/qa_prompt.go:59-87 filters to Go paths and returns nil, nil when none. internal/sprint/qa.go:489-531 skips shards with empty approvedPaths or selects descriptor fallback to true, and buildQAEvidencePublication at 488-494 continues when len(approvedPaths)==0. Non-Go shards (md, html, js, sql) receive no gofmt check.
theories.confirmation_condition: Construct a QAMap with only README.md or internal/foo.js changed paths, call ApprovedQAChecks and observe zero descriptors and that the assigned shard's ApprovedChecks is empty; confirm evidence bundle skips it
theories.refutation_condition: Show product policy intentionally limits auto-checks to Go and that handbook/governance covers non-Go via manual review or that empty check catalog is treated as blocked coverage via qa_map.go:259-265
theories.inconclusive_condition: Cannot execute ApprovedQAChecks with live filesystem writes or run the evidence isolation in read-only mode
theories.safe_evidence_strategy: Read qa_prompt.go, qa_map.go qaBehaviorGroup allowlist, and qa_synthesis follow-up paths; search ApprovedQAChecks callers; inspect existing ApprovedChecks serialization in qa_map_test.go

theories.claim: QAStore.PruneAttempts retains newest N by modtime but preserves the protected attempt regardless of age, allowing stale protected attempts to pin unbounded state growth when combined with VerificationBytes hard limit
theories.basis: internal/sprint/qa_state.go:82-136 keeps protected attempt unconditionally then keeps newest retained-1 others sorted by modtime descending. internal/sprint/qa.go:334-342 checks VerificationBytes > StateBytes budget before mapping. A protected attempt that is very old but referenced as CurrentAttemptID is never pruned, so repeated failed runs can accumulate up to retainedAttempts-1 newest plus one pinned old attempt that never ages out, approaching StateBytes limit without effective reclamation.
theories.confirmation_condition: Read PruneAttempts logic and show a protected attempt older than all others remains after multiple prunes while VerificationBytes grows; measure that StateBytes check occurs only at RunQA entry not after each Publish
theories.refutation_condition: Show retention bound of 8 plus 128MiB hard limit and per-record 128MiB cap in writeRecord:625 plus post-publish PruneAttempts at qa.go:699 guarantees reclamation before limit, or that protected is always the current semantic attempt which is also among newest after successful publish
theories.inconclusive_condition: Cannot create artificial attempt directories or measure filesystem bytes without writes
theories.safe_evidence_strategy: Read qa_state.go PruneAttempts sorting and keep logic, qa.go VerificationBytes check, and DefaultQABudgets StateBytes/RetainedAttempts; search for PruneAttempts call sites

theories.claim: Target identity drift check window allows symlink replacement between pre- and post-shard identity captures without detection of transient escape
theories.basis: internal/sprint/qa_prompt.go does path allowlisting via inside() at request build, but runtime enforcement is deferred. internal/sprint/qa.go:831-852 captures targetIdentity before and after runtime.StartRun and compares digests. targetIdentity at internal/sprint/verify.go:349-443 evaluates symlinks via EvalSymlinks per file and hashes contents up to 64MiB. A symlink swapped after the before-snapshot and restored before the after-snapshot would produce identical before/after digests while having escaped during the investigation.
theories.confirmation_condition: Demonstrate in an isolated copy that switching a symlink to an outside target during a bounded sleep inside StartRun yields equal before/after digests while the runtime had an escaped read, and that policy path rules do not cover the transient target
theories.refutation_condition: Show runtime process isolation with read_only sandbox and restricted path rules independently denies symlink escape regardless of digest equality, or that targetIdentity includes symlink value hashing (verify.go:418-420) that would differ after restore to different link target as shown in qa_prompt_test.go:165-205
theories.inconclusive_condition: Cannot invoke runtime or manipulate filesystem symlinks in read-only investigation
theories.safe_evidence_strategy: Read verify.go targetIdentity symlink handling, qa.go drift checks, and qa_prompt_test.go symlink tests; list allowed path rules; search for inside() definition
